extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: SimpleVlogEditor opens the video, music and image files you choose from your Desktop, and writes exports back where you ask.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: SimpleVlogEditor opens the video, music and image files you choose from your Documents, and writes exports back where you ask.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: SimpleVlogEditor opens the video, music and image files you choose from your Downloads, and writes exports back where you ask.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SimpleVlogEditor records narration with your microphone only while you are recording.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: SimpleVlogEditor records video with your camera only while you are recording.
